verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a SaaS marketing platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Mailchimp's own source is published under an open license. The only open-source mention is Mailchimp Open Commerce (formerly Reaction Commerce), a separate commerce stack rather than the Mailchimp product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
